key_conclusions: 09.001:2024 excludes foods at or above 40% fat and milk powder; approximate method capability for Pb 0.4 mg/kg and Cu 3 mg/kg is NOT validated lab LOQ.
09.005:2024 includes Pb ICP-MS around 0.04 mg/kg DRY matter, not automatically current food legal limit nor as-sold weight basis.
09.006:2024 chromium/nutrition scope is restricted; Ni is internal standard for Cr/Mo and NOT a tested contaminant in the method.
09.003:2024 includes nickel in element wavelength table; lab must prove actual matrix applicability and required LOQ.
FSSAI 0.010:2023 covers selected dairy/nutritional minerals but not lead; dairy matrix membership does NOT equal lead applicability.

method_cards.title: Microwave digestion with AAS
method_cards.matrix_scope: Lead and cadmium GFAAS; copper, zinc, iron FAAS for a variety of foods. Excludes >=40% fat foods and milk powder.
method_cards.limitation: Sensitivity figures are approximate method capabilities and not legal limits or a particular laboratory's accredited LOQ.

method_cards.title: Microwave digestion plus ICP-AES
method_cards.matrix_scope: Multi-element ICP-AES method; element wavelength listing includes Ni/Cr/Pb/Cu. Lab must substantiate actual validated detection capability and matrix.
method_cards.limitation: Appearance in ICP-AES wavelength table does not mean all low regulatory contaminant limits can be measured reliably.

method_cards.title: Pressure digestion with ICP-MS
method_cards.matrix_scope: Arsenic, cadmium, mercury and lead determination for a variety of foods. Pb capability approximately 0.04 mg/kg dry matter; matrix/basis verified for as-sold sample.
method_cards.limitation: Dry-matter analytical capability is not automatically comparable to a wet-weight, fat-free, reconstituted or ingredient-specific CTR threshold.

method_cards.title: ICP-MS chromium, selenium, molybdenum in infant/adult nutritional products
method_cards.matrix_scope: Infant formula and adult nutritional products only; chromium is analyte, nickel and tellurium are internal standards.
exclusions: Ordinary confectionery and Misri outside demonstrated scope
method_cards.limitation: Nickel as an internal standard does NOT make nickel a target contaminant result; chromium scope does not cover ordinary Misri.

method_cards.title: Trace minerals in dairy products and infant/nutritional formula
method_cards.matrix_scope: Minerals including copper in listed dairy/nutritional products; chromium excluded for dairy products. Lead not included in this analytical target list.
exclusions: Chromium excluded in dairy product scope
method_cards.limitation: Never label a milk-method mineral panel as an approved lead method.
